name: Injection guard
subject: Tool results a coding agent reads (web pages, search results, MCP results, files from outside the project, network command output), judged for prompt injection before the agent acts on them. Pass leaves the result alone; warn tells the agent the result is untrusted data; block removes or neutralises the offending text where the agent lets a hook rewrite the result, and records a taint that makes the gate stricter for the rest of the session.

sources.note: Which tool results are inspected. A result is inspected when its tool name matches one kind's `tools` and, for `file`, when the path is outside the repository (the nearest directory holding .git above the working directory, else the working directory) or its path inside the repository matches `paths` (third-party trees), and never when the absolute path matches `exclude` (credential files, whose content must not go to Jev); for `shell`, when the command matches `commands`. `jev`: always (every inspected result goes to Jev, engine jev) or signals (only results with a deterministic hit). An adapter that knows a tool is an MCP tool says so, whatever its name.

blockAt.label: Block at addressed
blockAt.note: Jev probability that a chunk tries to direct the agent, for a block.

severityAt.label: Block at severity
severityAt.note: Jev severity (0 none, 1 mild, 2 serious, 3 severe) for a block.

benignBelow.label: Jev clears phrase hits below
benignBelow.note: A phrase-level hit (override, role, to_ai) is cleared when Jev is this sure the chunk does not direct an AI, e.g. an article quoting an injection. Hidden text and exfiltration links are never cleared.

block.label: Block
block.blurb: Offending text removed where the agent allows; the session is tainted

warn.label: Warn
warn.blurb: The agent is told the result is untrusted data; the session is tainted

gates.label: Instructions hidden from a human?
gates.rule: instructions hidden from a human reader (invisible text, HTML comment or hidden element, encoded blob)

gates.label: Exfiltration link?
gates.rule: a markdown image or link that would send data to a remote host

gates.label: Jev: directs the agent, seriously?
gates.rule: text that tries to make the agent act: {attack} (severity {severity})

gates.label: Jev: only informs?
gates.rule: phrase hits in text that informs rather than directs (addressed {addressed})

gates.label: Override plus an action?
gates.test: override >= 1 and acts >= 1 or to_ai >= 1 and acts >= 1 or role >= 1 and acts >= 1
gates.rule: text addressed to an AI agent that asks it to run code, read secrets or send data

gates.label: Jev: directs the agent?
gates.rule: text that tries to direct the agent: {attack}

gates.label: Override, role marker or text to an AI?
gates.rule: text addressed to an AI agent (instruction override, role marker or direct address)
